en: This is the top floor. Our president's office is right this way. Please, follow me!
President, this is the trainer who got the Devon Goods back from Team Aqua.
So you are the one! I'm Stone, the president of Devon. You have my deepest thanks.
Those parts are for an important project. If they had gone missing, we'd have lost months of work.
I'd like to give you something. Here, this is our newest product, the PokéNav.
It has a map of Hoenn, and much more besides. I hope it serves you well on your travels.
Now, I hate to ask more of you, but might I trouble you with two errands?
First, this letter. It is for my son, Steven. He is somewhere in Dewford Town, across the sea.
And second, the Devon Goods. Please take them to Captain Stern at the shipyard in Slateport City.
Mr. Briney, the sailor on Route 104, will surely take you across the water if you ask him.
Your Pokémon look tired. Let me see to them before you go.
My son Steven is in Dewford Town, and Captain Stern awaits the goods in Slateport. I'm counting on you!
That PokéNav was my team's work. I hope you like it! Try the map: it shows where you are in Hoenn.
